title: Venezuelan Empanadas
description: A classic Venezuelan dish, these empanadas are filled with a delicious blend of ingredients. They can be served as a snack or a light meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Add the olive oil and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it is smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece of dough into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon or two of the empanada filling in the center of each circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with a little water.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little olive oil.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
